header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:menota:anonymous:rígsþula:am-242-fol, from the Medieval Nordic Text Archive, Menota (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. notes.1.321: Konr ungr, 'Kon the Young' (literally 'young kinsman'), plays on konungr, 'king'. ævinrúnar and aldrrúnar, 'runes of eternity' and 'runes of life', are of uncertain force. Rig Jarl is Jarl ('Earl'), Kon's father, who bears Rig's name.

nodes.text: He learned the speech of birds,
to soothe and lull to sleep,
